11 AI scenario cards

3 industrial test scenarios + 8 application scenarios

S1

Jingzhang Zero Co-track Test Line

Build a shared-track test section on the retained rails for autonomous vehicles and robots; three graded test sections (closed/semi-open/open).

S2

Affordable Compute Station

Set up shared compute and model evaluation platform in Zhongzhiyuan to address the 'expensive compute' pain point.

S3

Urban Governance Sandbox

Open traffic, environment, and city-management interfaces as a sandbox for testing.

S4

AI+ Traffic Green-Wave Corridor

Optimize signal green waves and bus priority using rail and bus big data.

S5

AI+ Education Developer Night School

Free AI courses and labs for developers and career changers.

S6

AI+ Legal Compliance Service Window

Smart agents for contract, IP, and compliance advice for startups.

S7

AI+ Healthcare Community Assistant

Community health monitoring and remote consultation terminals based on medical POIs.

S8

AI+ Unmanned Retail & Robot Delivery

Pilot unmanned retail cabinets and delivery robots in key area blocks.

S9

AI+ Public Space Smart Sensing

Environmental monitoring, smart spraying, and micro-climate adjustment.

S10

AI+ Heritage Digital Tour

AR overlay of century-old railway scenes, herringbone-line animation, and AI-generated narrative.

S11

AI+ Smart Parking Hub

Eco-parking lots and reservation system to address green-space vs parking conflicts.
